materials.name: M_VeyraHitFlash
materials.purpose: ADR-063 §2: the hit flash, drawn as an overlay over any unit's body or art (static or skinned); additive and unlit, brightest at the silhouette, and as bright under any exposure.

materials.name: PP_VeyraHoverOutline
materials.purpose: ADR-063 §3: outlines the hovered unit from its custom-depth stencil, in its side's colour; enemies thicker. Applied as a blendable on the local camera.

materials.name: PP_VeyraToonInk
materials.purpose: ADR-068 §3: the toon characters' ink, a screen-space line wherever a character's visible surface lies nearer than what it covers: its silhouette and its overlapping parts, as wide on screen at any distance, in a darkened tone of the nearer colour, its edge softened where fewer neighbours see that surface. Drawn before the temporal upscaler, which smooths it with the scene. Characters write their custom depth with this stencil; the hover outline keeps its own.

materials.name: M_VeyraFxFlare
materials.purpose: ADR-068 §4: a graphic flash, a hard-edged disc with a white-hot heart in its colour that shrinks and dims as it ages; the heart of a hit, a death or a projectile's trail.

materials.name: M_VeyraFxRing
materials.purpose: ADR-068 §4: a graphic shockwave, a hard-edged band that bursts out from a small ring to the sprite's edge, white-hot on its inner edge, thinning to nothing as it ages; a cast, a death or a level-up.

materials.name: M_VeyraFxStar
materials.purpose: ADR-068 §4: a graphic spark, a four-pointed star with a white-hot heart that shrinks to a point as it ages; the strike of a hit.

materials.name: M_VeyraFxStreak
materials.purpose: ADR-068 §4: a graphic streak, a long diamond drawn along its particle's flight with a white-hot spine that narrows away as it ages; sparks thrown off a hit, a cast's thrust, a level-up's rise.

materials.name: M_VeyraTelegraphFill
materials.purpose: ADR-068 §4: the shaded ground under a telegraph's outline: a faint fill of its side's colour, deepening toward its edge, and an inner fill that grows from its origin to its edge as it lands. The presentation draws it on a flat quad and gives its shape (0 a circle, 1 a sector, 2 a rectangle), half-arc, size, colour and how far it has landed.

materials.name: M_VeyraSmoke
materials.purpose: ADR-064 §1: a body of stylized smoke (Nix), drawn by particles; each puff a solid, ragged, sunlit blob that glows young and erodes through holes as it ages.

materials.name: M_VeyraEffectPuff
materials.purpose: ADR-063 §4: the puff every combat effect's sprites draw with; a solid, ragged ball that flares white-hot as it is born, cools into its side colour and darkens as it erodes away through holes, glowing alike under any exposure.

materials.name: M_VeyraEffectStrand
materials.purpose: ADR-063 §4: the strand every combat effect's ribbons draw with; the puff's look drawn along a ribbon, white-hot at its young head and fraying away from its old tail.

materials.name: M_VeyraFoam
materials.purpose: ADR-064 §1: the foam and spray a living wave throws (Neris), drawn by particles; each fleck a solid, ragged, sunlit white blob that erodes as it falls.

materials.name: M_VeyraDenseFog
materials.purpose: Dense Fog: scalloped translucent clouds, broad toon shade bands and rolling internal curls; presentation only.
